study.question: At the incumbent and full-derivative checkpoints, do the existing donor permutations change the fixed-state product-channel and accumulated shared category/brand embedding gradients despite conserving the eligible scalar scale multiset? Can source/forward/VJP bridges pass before any later authorized paired-seed robustness study?
study.hypothesis: Conservation of per-history scalar scale moments does not conserve prediction-sensitivity gradients after tangent directions, tied embeddings and parallel forward paths are combined. Existing donor rules can therefore produce different total embedding-gradient directions and norms at identical parameters and predictions. This is a local diagnostic hypothesis, not a claim that these differences mediate training gains. The seed-42 AUC ordering may still be initialization/selection noise.

nearest_work.difference: No training-mechanism difference. This diagnostic descendant inherits every training-method AST verbatim and adds common-checkpoint VJPs to investigate an explicitly unresolved explanation.

Existing rank/chronological ordering-by-offset cells are counterfactual diagnostic rules, not newly selected donor algorithms. They share one probe checkpoint at a time rather than being compared through their distinct learned states.

Full and fixed-tangent are inherited anchors. Current exported Model supports these modes; the historical full source itself is not exported. A current-source full-mode control checks aggregate replay and supplies a second checkpoint for exactly the same diagnostics.

study.proposed_difference: Only candidate-specific diagnostics change. Submit scale_half_audit (incumbent diagnostic descendant) and full_audit (same-source full-derivative control). Each training procedure is inherited; this is deliberately a source/measurement bridge, not a new architecture, donor sweep or independent repetition. New diagnostics compare full, fixed 0.2 tangent, chronological adjacent/half and inverse-norm-rank adjacent/half at common parameters. The scalar objective is mean prediction logit on first min(32,B) of the host first-512 diagnostic rows. Measure VJPs w.r.t. raw product and the unique category/brand embedding weight tensors, including every shared-parameter path. No labels, training hooks, parameter updates, optimizer states, cross-row model features or additional input data are used. First-512 forward/conservation summaries and inherited synthetic VJP audits complete 62 scalar keys.
predictions: Both replays reproduce their corresponding prior seed-42 aggregate AUC/Logloss and slices under unchanged host execution. Any discrepancy is investigated as a bridge failure, never interpreted as improvement or new seed evidence.

At either checkpoint, all six rules give identical probe logits up to float32 numerical tolerance (absolute maximum <=1e-6), and inherited synthetic float64 VJP scaled errors are <=1e-8. All diagnostics must be finite; floor/boundary synthetic cases remain explicit.

Four donor rotations preserve eligible row scale sum and squared sum within relative error 1e-5; this is a manipulation check only. The fixed 0.2 anchor does not preserve those moments and is not subject to that check.

For a nondegenerate full reference gradient (norm >=1e-12), at least one donor rule yields embedding relative gradient difference >1e-5 at a common checkpoint. Report product and total embedding norm ratios, cosines and relative differences for ALL five non-full rules; there is no predicted ordering of AUC or gradient norms.

An observed gradient difference only demonstrates local prediction-sensitivity change. Even agreement at both checkpoints is not repeated training mechanism evidence, a training-loss-gradient result, an Adam update result or proof of mediation.
falsifiers: Any source/training-method divergence, nonfinite diagnostic, host diagnostic execution failure, same-state logit error >1e-6, inherited VJP error >1e-8, or rotation moment error >1e-5 suspends attribution. Retain failed receipts and costs; do not hide discrepancies with relaxed contracts.

If full reference gradients are nondegenerate but all donor embedding relative differences are <=1e-5 at both checkpoints, the local probe hypothesis is unsupported. If reference gradients are <1e-12, ratios/cosines are considered degenerate and the test is inconclusive, not supportive.

Even positive common-state results cannot falsify seed-specific ranking, training-loss or Adam-trajectory alternatives. They cannot establish that negative donor correlation or temporal locality causes the AUC ordering.

Later paired nonpositive scale-half-minus-full/fixed means or a nonnegative ordering-by-offset AUC interaction would weaken reliability; seeds 43/44 remain unobserved and are not requested through an unauthorized config override.
alternative_explanations: Mean-logit sensitivity on ordered first-32 validation rows is not the labeled training objective or training distribution; the cotangent may miss the consequential directions.

Total embedding gradients mix the manipulated product path with unchanged history/query/direct classifier paths; cancellation or dilution can produce agreement or disagreement. Product-channel VJPs are reported separately.
Checkpoint-specific learned norms, ReLU states and tied field frequencies account for probe differences. Two trained checkpoints are not common training trajectories or independent seeds.
Seed-42 initialization, adaptive validation reuse and best-checkpoint selection explain the tiny performance rankings. Current proposal cannot authorize paired research seeds.
Stable rank ties, repeated category/brand fields, temporal spacing and donor assignment remain coupled. These diagnostics do not identify negative correlation, temporal or behavioral semantics.
Scale moments and parameter/data-pass equality do not equate actual gradient energies, Adam moments, updates or compute. No optimizer state is available.

Unexported host initialization/data-order/checkpoint behavior or device precision could break a replay even though local training ASTs are unchanged; investigate instead of treating this as a scientific effect.

observation_record.statement: Feature-only, pooled and target-aware reference AUCs are 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861; history additions reduce Logloss. This establishes useful predictive history signal without identifying a semantic limitation.
All 39 allowed model trials succeeded and have null errors; previous_runtime_error is null. Scientific negative and abandoned branches remain evidence; no unseen execution failures are invented.
Full count correction reduces pooled and DIN AUC. Half correction helps pooling by 0.0005804055 but reduces DIN AUC by 0.0002082243; partial correction did not rescue this target-aware branch.

Aligned raw products improve the ordinary product adapter by 0.0011629547 AUC; the ordinary adapter itself remains slightly below original DIN. Removing only off-diagonal products also helps, so both restrictions cannot receive undivided credit. Same-seed round-4/raw bridges reproduce these aggregates.

Unit normalization helps aligned AUC by 0.0004876568; crossed unit normalization barely changes AUC and worsens loss. Aligned exceeds crossed at equal unit norm, weakening a solely explicit product-magnitude explanation but leaving field/coordinate/optimization explanations.

Full aligned derivative exceeds detached, tangent-only and identity surrogate AUC in the original gradient factorial, but fixed 0.2 tangent and identity surrogates later approach the full result. Exact adaptive scale or projection necessity is not established.

Whole-history mean retains AUC near full/fixed but worsens Logloss. Chronological half-rotation loses AUC; action mean and action-half controls do not rescue it. Chronological adjacent recovers AUC in both groupings. Retain the negative branches and the rule-specific nature of that recovery.
The latest chronological-half bridge exactly reproduces r0009-history_reassigned AUC, Logloss and all slices. It is a deterministic lineage check, not a new seed.

Inverse-norm rank adjacent and half have AUCs 0.6150251061 and 0.6151021885. Scale-half exceeds the previous incumbent by 0.0001034468, full by 0.0001204973 and fixed by 0.0001133430; its Logloss also improves against all three. Scale-adjacent has the lowest recorded Logloss 0.1965201288. Both latest leaders remain seed-42 exploratory results.

Chronological adjacent-minus-half AUC is +0.0002689085; rank adjacent-minus-half is -0.0000770824. The rank-minus-chronological interaction is -0.0003459909. Rank ordering improves both offsets, more strongly for half. Adjacent has lower Logloss than half in both orders, so AUC and loss do not share the same ordering interaction.

The latest rules retain 17130275 parameters, including 51587 dense parameters; wall times are 635.69 and 639.45 seconds and peak memory 835099136 bytes. Cost is measured descriptively; equal parameter counts/data passes do not establish equal compute.

diagnostic_contract.scope: Host first-512 validation rows; only mean-logit VJP subset is first min(32,B). All within-checkpoint rule comparisons use identical row identities and one shared graph. No labels are accepted/read.
diagnostic_contract.measurements: For five non-full rules versus full: product/embedding gradient norm ratio, relative difference and cosine; full product/embedding gradient norms and sample count; maximum common logit difference. First-512 rotation moments/correlations and inherited synthetic two-probe ten-mode autograd audit. 62 named scalars.
diagnostic_contract.formula: G_mode=grad_theta mean_b logit_b(mode), theta=unique category/brand embedding weight tensors, includes all direct/query/history/product paths. Product VJP is separately grad_raw_product. Norms concatenate tensors conceptually via summed dot products; no per-row independence claim. Ratios floor denominators at 1e-30; full norms <1e-12 are declared degenerate at analysis.
diagnostic_contract.precision: float32 tensors/products with float64 reductions in probe dot products; inherited synthetic audit CPU float64. Host actual execution unverified locally.
diagnostic_contract.safety_of_measurement: torch.enable_grad only within diagnostics; torch.autograd.grad returns tensors without populating .grad; no backward/create_graph, optimizer call, data access, RNG draw, parameter/buffer/state mutation or update. retain_graph released on last rule. Probe slicing reads only the six declared feature keys, even if an extra host key were present.
diagnostic_contract.interpretation: Local label-free sensitivity; no actual training-loss, per-step gradients, Adam moments, updates, training-time mediation, significance, novel mechanism or seed robustness.
